title: Donald Trump attacks George W. Bush on 9/11, Iraq
summary: CBS News clip from a 2016 Republican primary debate in which Donald Trump attacks George W. Bush over 9/11 and the Iraq War while Jeb Bush defends his brother. It is a short, heated exchange on national security records.
why: Cited as the moment Trump supposedly broke the Bush dynasty's hold on the GOP by making the Iraq War a wedge issue.

quote.text: Trump overthrew the Bush dynasty by eviscerating Jeb over the Iraq War
